Workshop services

Railings and window grilles in Riyadh

We fabricate and install stair railings, balcony rails and protective window grilles in Riyadh. Railings follow the stair run or balcony edge, while grilles fit each door or window opening and can match the pattern of the facade.

Materials and finish

Specifications and options

What measurements do railings and window grilles need?

For stairs, note the number of steps, landing lengths and whether you need one or two sides. For grilles, list each window’s width, height and opening direction. If the windows are also being replaced, coordinate the measurements with the aluminum window installation.

  • Galvanized iron or stainless steel options.
  • Modern and traditional patterns.
  • Protective designs that suit the facade.
  • Resistance to rust and weather.
  • Choice of finishes and coatings.
  • Secure anchoring for rails and grilles.
From survey to installation

How we work

  1. 01

    Measurement

    We measure the staircase or balcony and any openings requiring grilles.

  2. 02

    Design selection

    We agree the material, bar pattern and finish.

  3. 03

    Workshop fabrication

    We form, weld and finish the pieces in the workshop.

  4. 04

    Installation

    We anchor the assemblies on site and check that they are secure.
